fields.question: What happens when a user clicks on a sharelink?
fields.answer: The sharelink sends the user to our servers, on which we place a 3rd party cookie with their referral code on `app.referralsaasquatch.com`, before forwarding them to your landing page so Squatch.js can drop a 1st party cookie. We store this cookie for 365 days, but browsers may drop them earlier. This means that if a user follows the sharelink, but not signs up immediately, we can still track the referral later. Please bear in mind that if the user clears their cache or switches to a different browser, we might not be able to track the referral. See our [1st party cookie guide](/developer/squatchjs/cookies/) for more.
